title: Re-mapping of keys gets jumbled when multiple keyboard languages are used.

status.label: Layout-dependent mapping is tracked in #9767
status.detail: The issue's requested per-layout behavior is tracked by open feature request #9767; remaps currently use virtual keys whose character meaning changes with the active layout.

judgment.rationale: The thread explains that the apparent remapping changes occur when the active keyboard layout assigns different characters to the same virtual key. A maintainer notes Keyboard Manager uses virtual keys, and commenters clarify that the desired behavior is a layout-specific override. The latest discussion points to #19781, which was closed as a duplicate of open issue #9767, the broader request for remapping based on input language. No separate current data-loss or mapping-corruption mechanism is established.
evidence: The original report lists PowerToys 0.59.0 and says remap labels change when switching between Swedish and English layouts.
A maintainer explains that Keyboard Manager uses virtual keys and asks whether the replacement still works when the layout changes.
A second user describes the same layout-dependent mapping issue with English and Russian layouts.
The original reporter confirms in July 2022 that the other user's description matches their issue.
Issue #19781 tracks keyboard-layout-dependent key overrides and was closed as a duplicate of open issue #9767.
judgment.recommended_action: Route the requested layout-dependent behavior to open issue #9767 rather than proposing a competing Keyboard Manager fix for the current virtual-key mapping model.

fix_assessment.rationale: The desired behavior is a per-layout remapping feature already tracked by open issue #9767, while the reported key-name changes are consistent with the current virtual-key mapping model. No separate code defect is established in this issue.

issue_context.summary: Keyboard remap labels appear to change across keyboard layouts because the same virtual key maps to different characters; users request layout-specific overrides.
known_information: The original report lists PowerToys 0.59.0 and Swedish/English layout switching.
A second user describes the same behavior across English and Russian layouts.
A maintainer explains that Keyboard Manager currently uses virtual keys.
Open issue #9767 tracks remapping based on input language; issue #19781 was closed as a duplicate of #9767.
inferences: The reported changes likely reflect the active layout's virtual-key meaning rather than corruption of the saved mappings.
issue_context.analysis: The requested per-layout override is tracked in #9767, and #19781 was routed there. Keep this issue linked to that feature request unless a current reproduction shows saved mappings themselves being corrupted beyond the layout-dependent interpretation.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue and all eleven comments, including both users' layout examples, the maintainer's virtual-key explanation, and the 2024 confirmation that the behavior persists.
Reviewed the current #9767 feature request and closed issue #19781; #19781 explicitly routes the layout-dependent override request to #9767.
